items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: I says, 'And I probably can get Bubble-eye.' Bubble-eye was Joe Keyes.

ctx.x: So they sent him back, see. And then they sent out in Kansas City and they got Ben, you know, to come. So now, all the band is breaking up and they're going back to Bennie Moten except -- well, I wasn't with Bennie Moten. But Basie was the last one to leave. So Nat Tolley is working for this man in Dallas, a gangster that owned half of Dallas -- nothing but money. Nat called me. He says, "I understand the band is breaking up." I said, "Yeah, it is." He says, "Well, who can I get out of it?" I says, "Well, I might…
